text:
maya: Quick intake — partner 'NextWave' dropped a neo-lite-7b (decoder-only) export for an alpha trial. Need a perf + quant pass this week: throughput/latency baseline, int8/int4 microbench, ctx sweeps up to 4096, and batching heatmap. Goal: decide Dedicated vs Hosted variant by EOD Fri. Please keep notes concise and link artifacts.

sam: I can own FP16 baselines. Will run on dedicated-7g queue, ETA ~2h.

arjun: I'll own the quant experiments (int8, awq-int4, q4_0). Plan: 1) kernel-backed int8, 2) awq int4, compare p50/p95 + small quality smoke. Need the eval set — @maya can you share?

maya: Eval set: https://internal.redwood/evals/neo-lite-smoke (200 prompts, mixed QA/completion/chat). Also include a warmup scenario: cold start vs warmed KV. Warmup recipe: send 8 requests of 16 tokens each before measurement.

beth: Bench harness: gitlab.com/redwood/bench/runner (branch: neo-lite). Command I'll run: `./bench --model neo-lite-7b --profile latency --batch-size 1,4,8 --ctx 512,1024,2048,4096 --kv-cache=true`. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-bench/neo-lite/1738509123/

ops-bot: Queued run on 'dedicated-7g' pool. Start ETA 10m.

sam: Note: set env `REDWOOD_BATCHER=max` to enable continuous batching during throughput runs. Also `--prefill-cpu=1` to reduce CPU-side stalls.

arjun: For int4 runs we should capture KV cache memory growth. Log pattern: `n_ctx * batch_size` memory and track >64GB as a hard stop.

elaine: Priority: alpha-customer trial. Risk: if p95 > 450ms at batch=1 we treat this as SLA risk and notify eng-sre.

maya: Quick bring-up checklist (first pass):
  1) Baseline FP16 latency sweep (p50/p95) across ctx {512,1024,2048,4096}.
  2) Int8 latency + quality smoke (same ctx).
  3) Int4 (awq/q4_0) latency + full quality regression against eval set.
  4) Batching heatmap: batch sizes 1,2,4,8,16 at ctx 512/1024.
  5) Deployment config PR (runtime flags, batching policy, fallback model).
  6) Canary rollout gating + link to runbook.

sam: Starting FP16 baseline now. Will post p50/p95 table and CSV to S3.

beth: benchbot: scheduled jobs (fp16-latency, int8-latency, int4-latency, batching-heatmap). Will push plots + raw CSVs once done.

arjun: Also use `--kv-sweep=true` flag in bench to capture cache hit/miss distribution.

maya: Quality gating: if int4 shows >3% drop in QA F1 or ROUGE vs FP16, hold the rollout and open a triage.

sam: FP16 quick results (a4g-dedicated, batch=1, ctx=512): p50=92ms, p95=210ms. Throughput at batch=8 ctx=1024 = ~780 tok/s. Full CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/neo-lite/1738509123/fp16.csv

beth: Uploaded plots + heatmaps: s3://redwood-bench/neo-lite/1738509123/plots.zip

arjun: Int8 quick pass: p95 ~240ms. AWQ int4: p95 ~330ms and throughput lower — starting quality regression now.

maya: Tagging ML-ops: please reserve a canary window Thursday 09:00-11:00 PST. Need an ops-approved rollback plan.

ml-ops: Noted. Reserving canary window Thurs 09:00-11:00 PST. Require final config PR + rollout steps 24h prior.

sam: Created perf notes doc: https://docs.redwood/notes/neo-lite/perf-1738509123 (contains raw numbers, hardware list, and quick recommendations).

beth: One infra blocker: observed CUDA 12.1 kernel fallback on some nodes for int4 kernels. Filing infra ticket.

ops-bot: Infra ticket created: INF-4821. Affected nodes: gpu-node-23, gpu-node-19.

maya: Action items (assign): sam = perf baselines + final report, arjun = quant + quality checks, beth = bench infra + artifacts upload, elaine = customer comms. Target: finalize by Fri EOD. :checkered_flag: 

sam: Will post final summary (CSV + short recommendations) once int4 quality finishes.

arjun: Quick caveat: if AWQ int4 quality marginal but latency wins, we may recommend int8 for canary and postpone int4 until further work on kernel/quant tuning.

beth: benchbot: all scheduled jobs completed, artifacts uploaded. Links added to the perf doc.

maya: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for perf/quant decisions. Ping here for any blockers. :raised_hands:
